reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown reread the Greek pronouns in 2 Timothy 2:26 so the Lord's servant, not Satan, does the capturing, in service of God's will rather than the devil's own.

sides.snippet: having been taken captive by him to his will.
sides.verseText: and they may recover themselves out of the devil's snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.

sides.snippet: But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
sides.verseText: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
